summary: Describes security extensions to the Licklider Transmission Protocol, which acts as a reliable convergence layer over single-hop deep-space radio links. LTP sends data and asks for selective acknowledgments, and it is stateful with no negotiation or handshakes. The extensions add protection, and the document is experimental.

eli5.summary: Space messages can be listened to or faked. This adds seals and secret codes to those messages, so the receiver can trust where they came from and that no one changed them.

questions: how to secure deep space communication
